LESSON: READING ALOUD

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: GERMAN
Strand: Reading 2.3 Skimming for information (2 Lessons) By the end of the sub- strand, 
Topic 2.5: Reading Aloud

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Reading Aloud
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: what activities people do in their free time; (z.B. Was machst du heute Abend?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. identify useful phrases in specific contexts for comprehension
2. read given texts with correct articulation for comprehension
3. appreciate the importance of articulation in reading comprehension

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Reading Aloud

• Listen to a model.
• Study the example.
• Then produce your own example.

▸ Reading Aloud

Teach
• Focus skill: identify useful phrases in specific contexts for comprehension.
• Use complete sentences.
• Speak clearly; write neatly.

Worked example
• Model sentence 1 about Reading Aloud.
• Model sentence 2 using a Kenyan school example.
• Model dialogue: A: “…?”  B: “…”

Try this
• Write 5 original sentences on this skill.
• Say one 30-second oral example to a partner.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• One clear model for Reading Aloud
• One Kenyan school/home example

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences.
2. Do one oral practice with a partner.
3. Correct spelling/punctuation.

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Revision sheet: meaning + 5 examples + 5 practice items.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. what activities people do in their free time; (z.B. Was machst du heute Abend?
2. when people (plan to) do leisure time activities; (z.B. Wann spielst du Fußball?
3. where people meet with friends for fun activities; How can one improve pronunciation in reading?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• Model first, then try.
• Use complete sentences.

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Classroom study notes (Strategy 2)
